summary.tldr: Creates a new Employment Insurance Board of Appeal and removes the need to ask leave before appealing some Employment Insurance decisions.
what_it_does: Creates the Employment Insurance Board of Appeal to hear appeals of decisions under the Employment Insurance Act, instead of the Employment Insurance Section of the Social Security Tribunal.
Eliminates the requirement to get leave to appeal Employment Insurance Act decisions to the Appeal Division of the Tribunal.
Makes related changes to other Acts.
